query: Howdy, I want a skirt in the sweet style. I'll check that myself, so don't fret (I've been burned before). It's gotta be something y'all actually have on hand, not just a listing on a website somewhere. Nothing over 475 cts, y'all (every penny counts when you're a student), 'cause I ain't climbing past that ridge. If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks).

rules: Only buy items available in store stock, not website-only listings.
Send no more than 3 messages to the shopper.
Use no more than 38 moves or tool calls.
If nothing fits, say so; do not offer substitutes.
